numiaerobridge.ponder.docking_connector_: A docked pair acts as one connection while both connector inventories and tanks remain independent.
Without a SalePoint bound, items and fluids pass through the pair using the normal connector behaviour.
Start with a fresh SalePoint item. Sneak-right-click a connector to switch its resource mode.
Right-click the connector with the selected SalePoint item to bind that connector pair as its target.
While the SalePoint controls the pair, incoming items are stored in its buffer. They are not delivered to the buyer yet.
The order is completed only after payment succeeds. The purchased quantity is then inserted into the opposite connector.
When the SalePoint is unbound, the pair returns to normal item transfer.
Use a fresh SalePoint item and sneak-right-click a connector to switch from item sales to fluid sales.
Right-click the connector again with the SalePoint item to select the pair as the sale target.
Incoming fluid is redirected into the SalePoint buffer. The connected connector tank does not receive it before payment.
After successful payment, only the ordered fluid amount is delivered to the opposite connector tank.
Orders larger than 1 litre are supported. The SalePoint still delivers the requested amount only after payment.
Unbinding the SalePoint restores normal fluid transfer between the connectors.
